The third quarter of 2026 was another exceptionally strong quarter for the Company, with profit after tax amounting to $270.9 million, reflecting continued robust tanker market conditions and strong
commercial performance. Profit after tax for the first nine months of 2026 reached $633.7 million, further extending the Company’s record earnings and underscoring the strength of the market environment and the Company’s operating platform.
QUARTERLY HIGHLIGHTS:
• |
In the third quarter of 2026, the Company achieved average combined time charter equivalent earnings of $141,300 per day, comprised of $167,100 per day for the Company’s VLCCs operating in the spot market and
$114,200 per day for the Company’s VLCCs on time charter.
• |
Adjusted EBITDA for the third quarter of 2026 was $269.5 million. Net profit for the quarter was $270.9 million, equating to $1.68 per basic share. After adjusting for the $34.2 million gain on
sale of DHT Bauhinia and the non-cash fair value gain related to interest rate derivatives of $2.2 million, the Company had ordinary net income for the quarter of $234.5 million, equating to $1.45 per basic share.
• |
In the third quarter, the Company entered into 3-year time charter agreements for the VLCCs DHT Jaguar, built in 2015, and DHT Panther, built in 2016. The vessels were fixed at rates of $75,000 per day and
$100,000 per day, respectively, under contracts concluded with global energy companies. The charter for DHT Jaguar commenced in September 2026, while the charter for DHT Panther commenced in October 2026.
• |
